title: Exception Types
description: Learn about common C# exception types and the exception hierarchy.

data.text: C# has a rich exception hierarchy. Understanding common exception types helps you write better error handling code.

data.title: Common Exceptions
Don't Catch SystemException
data.text: Avoid catching SystemException. It includes serious runtime errors like OutOfMemoryException. Only catch exceptions you can handle.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Create custom exceptions for app-specific errors
Only catch exceptions you can handle
data.takeaway: Know the common exceptions to handle them properly.
